description: Defines the vrb_alloc structure for VRB resource allocation, supporting two allocation types (RBGs and VRB range), with methods for managing and querying resource grants, and a conversion function for RBG to PRB bitmaps.

classes.name: ocudu::vrb_alloc
classes.description: Represents a VRB resource allocation that can be of type 0 (RBGs) or 1 (VRB range), with methods for creation, copying, and querying the allocation type and contents.

methods.name: convert_rbgs_to_prbs
methods.description: Converts an RBG bitmap to a PRB bitmap given BWP PRB dimensions and nominal RBG size.
